subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence sprint, retention update & capacity bump request
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@finledger.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Neal <cneal@finledger.com>, LegalOps <legalops@finledger.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation window and evidence needs

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well. FinLedger is kicking off our SOC 2 re-attestation and we want to coordinate evidence collection and a short shadow audit with Redwood. High level asks:

- We’ll need a 90-day retention bump for auth/logging artifacts (to cover FY coverage requested by our auditors).
- A short ‘evidence sprint’ where we pull and review log bundles and config snapshots (approx 2 engineers from our side).
- A temporary burst of additional throughput to export ~1.2TB of logs for the audit window (target week of Sep 20).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (a) provide an evidence checklist we can map to controls, (b) temporarily increase retention for our tenant, and (c) approve burst capacity pricing and delivery lead time?

I attached an initial log_manifest.csv and a retention_matrix.xlsx that shows our asks. We’re planning a shadow audit the week of Sep 27 — would like to have the bulk transfer done a week prior.

Thanks — if possible, can we grab a 30-min sync? I’m available Sep 2 afternoon PT or Sep 3 morning PT.

— Alex
Alex Turner
Sr. Security Program Manager | FinLedger
alex@finledger.com | +1 415-555-0194
Attachments: log_manifest.csv (csv stub), retention_matrix.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@finledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation window and evidence needs

Alex — thanks for the note and the manifests. We can support the flow you described; below is a proposed mutual action plan and immediate asks so we can scope pricing and timing.

Mutual action plan (draft)
- By Sep 4: Redwood to share SOC 2 evidence checklist + mapping to common control categories (CC1–CC6) and an initial estimate for retention change (storage + egress).
- Sep 7: Joint review call to validate the log_manifest and identify any gaps. (30 min)
- Sep 14–18: Evidence sprint — staged exports and review sessions.
- Sep 20–24: Bulk transfer window (temporary burst capacity to be enabled).

Immediate asks for us to scope:
1) Confirm which log streams (auth, api, infra) you need exported and the date ranges for each.
2) Confirm whether FinLedger requires preserved chain-of-custody for exported bundles.
3) Do you want Redwood to host exported bundles in a temporary encrypted bucket or will you pull them directly?

Ben — can you draft a burst-capacity quote and a short change-order for the retention bump (FinLedger is asking ~90 days extra)? Laura — can you coordinate a CS liaison for the sprint and share contact names for FinLedger’s two engineers.

I’ll attach our evidence_index.docx and the SOC 2 checklist in advance of Sep 4.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Security | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachments: evidence_index.docx (docx stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex@finledger.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation window and evidence needs — capacity & pricing note

Kim / Alex — looping in pricing and delivery. Quick notes:

- Burst capacity: We can provision a one-time burst for the Sep 20–24 window to handle the ~1.2TB export. Estimated incremental cost: $1,350 for the burst window (includes GPU time & network egress), plus storage egress at $0.09/GB.
- Retention bump: 90-day retention extension will increase stored token logs and index retention. Estimated recurring delta: $420/mo (storage + index retention overhead). We’ll prepare a formal change order.
- Change-order path: We’ll submit a small amendment to the existing MSA that covers the retention term, burst period, and a 15% seat uplift (if FinLedger confirms).

Next steps for us: I’ll provide a draft quote and a one-page change-order by Sep 3 EOD. Laura — please confirm availability to run the evidence sprint ops and provide a single point-of-contact for FinLedger.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation window and evidence needs — confirmation & artifacts

Kim, Ben, Laura — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming:

- We’ll take the Sep 3 EOD draft quote and proposed change-order. Please include the seat uplift language (we anticipate going +15% seats on renewal).
- We confirm auth + api + infra log streams for the entire FY window; I uploaded a cleaned log_manifest.csv and a retention_matrix.xlsx to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFINLEDGER
- Chain-of-custody: FinLedger prefers that Redwood stage the encrypted bundles in your transient S3 bucket for collection; we’ll reference checksums in the evidence_index.docx.

Meeting: Sep 3 at 2:30 PM PT works for our team — please send an invite.

We’ll run a short shadow audit Sep 27–29 (internal) and will need the exports complete by Sep 20 so auditors can sample. Once we have the draft change-order we can route to LegalOps for a quick review.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

— Alex
Alex Turner
Sr. Security Program Manager | FinLedger
alex@finledger.com
Attachments uploaded: log_manifest.csv, retention_matrix.xlsx
